title: Epistemic Diversity and Knowledge Collapse in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the epistemic diversity of model outputs for country-specific topics (historical events and public figures across 12 countries) using Hill-Shannon Diversity to evaluate how cultural context and region impact the representation of generated claims.

Matching LLM-generated claims about country-specific topics to claims found in English Wikipedia versus local language Wikipedia using multilingual sentence embeddings and an LLM-as-a-judge to quantify the underrepresentation of non-English knowledge.
